EXTRAORDINARY 
PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY 
MONDAY, MARCH 12, 2018/PHALGUNA 21, 1939 
Separate paging is given to this Part in order that it may be filed as a Separate Compilation. 
PART IV 
Acts of Gujarat Legislature and Ordinances promulgated and Regulations 
made by the Governor. 
The following Act of the Gujarat Legislature, having been assented to by the 
Governor on the 71h March, 2018 is hereby published for general information. 
K.M.LALA, 
Secretary to the Government ofGujarat, 
Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Department. 
GUJARAT ACT NO.5 OF 2018. 
(First published, after having received the assent of the Governor, in the "Gujarat 
Government Gazette", on the l2
1h March, 2018). 
AN ACT 
further to amend the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993. 
It is hereby enacted in the Sixty-ninth Year of the Republic of India 
as follows:-
1. 
(1) This Act may be called the Gujarat Panchayats (Amendment) Act, Shorttitleand 
2018. 
(2) It shall come into force at once. 
2. In the Gujarat Panchayats Act; 1993,in section 55, in sub-section (4), for the 
Amendment of words "Sarpanch or a member of the panchayat authorized in that behalf by the 
section 55 of 
Guj.18 of 1993. panchayat, and the Secretary", the words "Sarpanch and the Secretary" shall be 
substituted. 
IV-Ex.-5-1 
5-1 
GOVERNMENT CENTRAL PRESS, GANDHINAGAR. 
commencement. 
Guj.18 of 1993.
